what: `Source::file(&self, name) -> Option<&str>` lends text borrowed from the world, and the steps need `W: 'static`, so a world over the VFS cannot read a file lazily through a `Pinned` (not 'static) or a `Reader` (its bytes are held, not lent). The daemon's world therefore holds a count of every file of the pinned root (`Bytes`, no copy), loaded once at the seed and updated from the Merkle diff each build: exact and O(changes), but O(files) memory for paths and counts.
cost: a quarter of the lane's reading, looking for an append-only arena (none in the tree) before choosing the held map
cause: the world trait was designed against a test world that owns its strings
class: a trait shaped by its first (test) implementation, not by the real one
prevention: a world trait's doc names the real world it must fit (the VFS's pinned tree) and that world is written with the trait
workaround: held map of `Bytes` per file, UTF-8 checked at each read
fix: none: a `Source::file` that gives `Bytes`/`Text` (owned count) would let the world read lazily
